content:
Apple TV will premiere its brand-new original comedy series "Brothers" next month, starring Michael Douglas and Will Ferrell. Here's the trailer.

"Brothers" will debut on September 23, with showrunner Lee Eisenberg from "The Office"

Apple TV is currently streaming season 4 of "Ted Lasso," but another highly anticipated comedy is just around the corner.

"Brothers" stars Michael Douglas and Will Ferrell as fictionalised versions of themselves in this brand-new original series.

"Brothers" will premiere on Wednesday, September 23, with the first two episodes dropping at launch, followed by weekly installments through November 4.

The series is showrun by Lee Eisenberg, who was a key member of the creative team behind the acclaimed sitcom "The Office." Eisenberg served as a writer and producer on the show from seasons 2 through 6.

Below is the synopsis and trailer for "Brothers" provided by Apple:

Also arriving on Apple TV this September: a new season of "Slow Horses," the original crime thriller "Last Seen," and the Ryan Reynolds film "Mayday."

What did you think of the "Brothers" trailer? Drop your thoughts in the comments.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, and you can also subscribe via the Apple One bundle.
